title.narrative: Advancing Education for Sustainable Development in UNESCO designated sites in Chile and Ecuador

description.narrative: Education for sustainable development equips people with the knowledge, attitudes, values and behaviours to actively contribute to a more peaceful and just world. Advancing ESD in Chile and Ecuador requires a holistic approach by providing locally relevant teaching materials and place-based learning experiences, where schools, educators, and community actors can connect global sustainability challenges with the realities of biosphere reserves, geoparks, marine and coastal ecosystems, and cultural landscapes. These sites offer unique opportunities to understand biodiversity, geodiversity, water, and ocean conservation while fostering stewardship, resilience, and community engagement. Expanding ESD through the Greening Education Partnership strengthens climate-ready learners and empowers local communities to become active agents of change, contributing directly to sustainable development and climate adaptation. In this biennium, UNESCO will continue working on guidelines to ESD in coastal and marine ecosystems and developing training of trainers on climate change to equip communities with up-to-date knowledge and foster climate action.
